scope:
Host checks of extracted workqueue allocation and cpuidle entry prefixes.

Mocks check allocation shape, cleanup and callback-adjusted limits. This is not
kernel execution, a scheduler test or proof of arbitrary vendor callback safety.
limits: Workqueue primitives mocked, native attribute limits modeled as 1..2048; failed original shape intercepted before an out-of-bounds write. No actual kernel allocation, concurrent callback registration, CPU idle or module execution.
